Short, cropped charcoal black hair with a rugged texture and a clean-shaven head on the sides. Small, narrow amber eyes with a stern, focused expression. Appears to be in late 30s with a mature, weathered face. Massive, muscular heavyweight build with a towering physique. Wears traditional Muay Thai attire consisting of deep crimson shorts with gold trim and matching hand wraps. Features distinctive traditional Thai tattoos covering the chest, arms, and shoulders.
